Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap

Class Dn

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap.Dn
public final class Dn extends Object
A Distinguished Name (DN): an ordered, most-specific-first sequence of Rdn components (RFC 4514). Parsing handles escaped separators; equality is name-normalized (types lower-cased, insignificant whitespace removed, multi-valued RDN ordering ignored).
